{{samename|{{p|Vullaby}} belonging to {{adv|White}} in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}|White (Adventures)#Barbara|White → Barbara}} [[File:Barbara.png|thumb|250px|Barbara]] '''Barbara''' (Japanese: '''イバラ''' ''Ibara'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG158|Queen of the Serpentine!]]''. ==In animation== In ''[[AG158|Queen of the Serpentine!]]'', Barbara proved to be quite an intimidating character as she took it upon herself to support [[Lucy]]. She was angered after {{Ash}} had already left for the [[Battle Pike]], so she and her friends couldn't officially welcome him to the facility. She became irritated with Brock after he showed feelings for Lucy, often telling him to keep quiet as he professed his love during the match. Barbara, however, will bow down in respect only to her master, Lucy. Usually, Lucy is the one that needs to tell her to watch her temper. Barbara is also overly confident in her master's skills as a [[Pokémon Trainer]] as well as her Pokémon. She belittled [[Jessie's Seviper]] saying that [[Lucy's Seviper]] was way better than hers. While during Ash's match, Barbara was in the sidelines cheering on Queen Lucy and pointed out Ash's flawed battle strategies. Ash later emerged victoriously and won himself the Luck Symbol, though Barbara was disappointed that Lucy didn't win. The dub states Barbara to be Lucy's younger sister, which is probably the misinterpretation of お姉さん ''Oneesan'', (the way Lucy's apprentices refer to her), which literally means "elder sister" but is also a polite way to refer to any older young woman. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=斉木美帆 ''Miho Saiki'' |en=[[Hilary Thomas]] |fi=Elise Langenoja |fr_eu=Géraldine Frippiat |it=Irene Scalzo |pt_br=Lene Bastos |es_eu=Carmen Podio }} ==In the manga== ===Ash & Pikachu=== [[File:Barbara AoP.png|thumb|100px|Barbara in Ash & Pikachu]] Barbara appeared in ''[[SP36|An Infinite Bond!!]]'', playing the same role as she does in {{aniseries|RS}}. {{-}}
